description: Hala Enterprises Limited is a terry towel manufacturer established in 1972, which began exporting to Europe and Japan in the late 1970s and by the 1980s had buyers and brands in the German and Italian markets. It makes private-label terry towels and related products, and works with clients to develop customised towels, across retail, institutional, hospitality, beach and kitchen lines.
